name: Konda (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Konda town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised mountain.
history: Flag of the former town of Konda in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 1999-04-01.

features.role: Konda town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised mountain
